title: Veggie Boys Start Tomato Planting
reason: The video details the planning and planting of tomatoes along with other crops at a farm, involving multiple steps of preparation and cultivation.

tasks.task: The preparation and planting of tomatoes in various varieties.

subtasks.text: Explain why multiple tomato varieties are being planted today.
Describe the method for transplanting different tomato varieties.
Identify and describe the unique cherry and grape tomatoes being planted.
Specify the heirloom tomato being planted and its characteristics.

tasks.task: Show the process of planting and cultivating different rounds of tomatoes.

subtasks.text: Introduce and plant the first distinct tomato variety.
Highlight the planting of another tomato variety by one of the helpers.
Describe the final preparation and planting of the last tomato variety.

tasks.task: Describe the cultivation and preparation of the field for future crops.

subtasks.text: Explain the importance of maintaining consistent planting spaces for future comparison.
Describe the necessity of weeding and soil management for crop health.
Explain the use of mulch for tomato cultivation.
